newsitem.title: USA: Northeast Utilities names nuclear execs.
newsitem.headline: Northeast Utilities names nuclear execs.

text.p: The head of Northeast Utilities announced Wednesday senior appointments in the company's troubled nuclear division.
Neil S. "Buzz" Carns will become senior vice president and chief nuclear officer - Millstone, said Northeast chairman, president and chief executive Bernard M. Fox in a statement.
Carns, formerly chairman and CEO of Wolf Creek Nuclear Operating Corp in Burlington, Kan, will start Feb 3.
He will report to Bruce Kenyon, president and chief executive of Northeast Nuclear Group, said Fox.
Michael H. Brothers was named recovery officer for Millstone Unit 3. He will report to Carns when he starts in early February, said Fox.
Brothers had been unit director for Millstone Unit 3 since 1994.

Kenyon said in a statement the addition of Carns to the Millstone team would allow Ted Feigenbaum, executive vice president and chief nuclear officer for Seabrook and Connecticut Yankee, to focus on those sites.

Northeast's three Millstone nuclear plants in Waterford have been closed for safety reasons since March of last year. The company has said it plans to have all three plants ready to be restarted by early 1998.
